links.outcome: LLM answer accuracy in Turkish versus English for pregnancy questions
links.effect: Gemini and DeepSeek answers to English questions had statistically higher accuracy than Turkish (p < 0.05); ChatGPT showed no general accuracy difference between languages.
links.quote: It was found that Google Gemini and DeepSeek's answers to English questions achieved statistically higher accuracy scores than their answers to Turkish questions (p < 0.05).

links.outcome: Reliability, validity and accessibility of references cited by LLM answers
links.effect: ChatGPT had the highest 'perfect reference' rate (78.5% Turkish, 71.4% English), implying the other models' references were less reliable; references may not always be reliable.
links.quote: In particular, it was found that the response quality of LLMs may suffer for non-native English speakers and that the references provided may not always be reliable.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and reference reliability of LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) answering real patient pregnancy questions in Turkish vs. English without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
